summary: Karyopharm Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a September 10, 2026 Forbearance Agreement and Limited Waiver with lenders under its May 8, 2024 Credit Agreement, holders of 100% of its 9.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 and 2029, the royalty investor representative, and Wilmington Savings Fund Society as agent/trustee. The company skipped a ~$15.8M principal installment and June 30 note interest, and does not expect September 30 cash interest payments; a $25.0M minimum liquidity covenant may be breached after October 10, 2026, creating specified defaults and cross-defaults. Watch for strategic-alternatives progress, equity raise terms, and forbearance expiry risk.
